lines.10: One more place, then your road. Tap Profile.
lines.11: Becoming a patient? Your documents live here. Start them now, or tap Next.
lines.12: Make the app yours here: light or dark, roomy or compact. Tap it to look, or tap Next. Refer a friend sits just below.
lines.13: This is your road. One stone a day. Tap the stone and we begin.
lines.02: I’m with you on every screen. Any question, type it here. Try one now, or tap Next.
lines.02b: That’s all it takes. Ask me like that from any screen.
lines.03: Or tap one of these and I’ll take you there. Try one, or tap Next.
lines.04: My job is to get you training without pain. Let’s start with what hurts: tap Train.
lines.05: This is the Pain Tool. Tap it.
lines.06: Tap the body where it hurts.
lines.07: Pick the picture that looks like your pain.
lines.08: These are your movements. If this is your pain, tap Add to my road and they’ll be waiting for you. If not, skip this step.
lines.09: This builds a workout for you in a few taps. Tap Build a workout.
lines.p1: Take your time. Tap Continue the tour when you’re ready.
lines.n1: Tap the spot that’s lit, or skip this step.
lines.n2: Tap the spot that’s lit, or tap Next.
lines.x1: No problem. I’m on every screen whenever you need me.
lines.z1: That’s the tour. I’m on every screen whenever you need me.
